payload.question: New messages and answers of yours no longer go into git, but the ones committed since early October are still tracked: about 70 messages, 150 answers, 60 first readings and 100 quotes. I can stop tracking them in the next commit; the files stay on this machine and plumb still reads them, but older commits keep them, and only a history rewrite erases those (which can't be undone and breaks other copies). What should happen?
